title: Set 67

sentences.ko: 7월에 그 에스프레소 머신을 하나 샀는데, 쓴 게 다섯 번쯤 될까 말까야. 원두 갈고 자잘한 부품 다 씻고 나면 10분인데, 화요일 아침에 나한테 그 10분이 없거든. 그래서 아직도 예전이랑 똑같이 매일 회사 앞 가게에 들러. 이제 와서 반품하기엔 한참 늦었고. 나 또 그런 거 산다고 하면 좀 말려 줘.
sentences.text: I bought one of those espresso machines back in July, and I've used it maybe five times, because by the time I grind the beans and wash all the little parts, that's ten minutes I don't have on a Tuesday morning. So I'm still stopping at the place by work every day, same as before. And it's way too late to send it back. Just don't let me buy anything like that again.

alts.text: Back in July I picked up one of those espresso machines, and I've used it maybe five times, because between grinding the beans and washing all the little parts, that's ten minutes I just don't have on a Tuesday morning. So I'm still hitting the place by work every day, same as always. And it's way past the point where I can send it back. Just don't let me buy anything like that again.

I purchased one of those espresso machines back in July, and I have used it perhaps five times, because by the time I grind the beans and wash all of the small parts, that is ten minutes I do not have on a Tuesday morning. As a result, I am still stopping at the shop near work every day, just as I did before. It is far too late to send it back. Please do not let me buy anything like that again.

sentences.note: **by the time**은 이것저것 다 하고 나면 이미 그렇게 되어 있다는 뜻입니다. **send it back**은 산 물건을 돌려보낸다, 즉 반품한다는 말입니다.

sentences.ko: 토요일에 달리기를 했어. 딱 2마일, 그게 다야. 근데 3월인가 그 뒤로 운동을 아예 안 했거든. 그랬더니 종아리가 너무 뭉쳐서 발끝으로 걸어 다니고, 소파에 앉는 것도 아주 한바탕 일이야. 제일 어이없는 건 토요일 밤에 내가 얼마나 뿌듯해했냐는 거지.
sentences.text: I went for a run on Saturday, and it was two miles, that's it, but I haven't done anything since like March. So now my calves are so tight I'm walking around on my toes, and sitting down on the couch is a whole production. The worst part is how proud of myself I was Saturday night.

alts.text: So I ran two miles on Saturday, that's all it was, but I haven't done anything since like March. Now my calves are so tight I'm walking around on my toes, and sitting down on the couch is a whole production. Worst part is how proud of myself I was Saturday night.

I went for a run on Saturday. It was two miles, nothing more, but I have not done anything since March. My calves are now so tight that I am walking on my toes, and sitting down on the couch has become quite an ordeal. The worst part is how proud of myself I was on Saturday night.

sentences.note: **a whole production**은 별것 아닌 일을 하는 데 온갖 수선을 떨어야 한다는 뜻입니다. **that's it**은 그게 전부라고 못박는 말입니다.

sentences.ko: 11월에 월세가 또 올라. 그쪽이 부르는 그 돈이면 라이언네 동네에서 방 하나 더 있는 집을 구할 수 있거든. 근데 그러면 출퇴근이 편도 한 시간이야. 지금은 걸어서 12분이면 회사에 가는데. 그래서 계산해 볼 때마다 숫자로는 말이 되는데, 2월에 그 길을 운전하고 있는 내 모습을 그려 보면 도저히 못 하겠어. 너라면 어떻게 할래?
sentences.text: Our rent goes up again in November, and for what they're asking we could get an extra bedroom out where Ryan lives. But then I'm looking at an hour commute each way, and right now I walk to work in twelve minutes. So every time I do the math it makes sense on paper, and then I picture myself doing that drive in February and I just can't do it. What would you do?

alts.text: They're raising our rent again in November, and for what they're asking we could get an extra bedroom out by Ryan's. But then I'm looking at an hour each way in the car, and right now I walk to work in twelve minutes. So every time I run the numbers it works on paper, and then I picture myself doing that drive in February and I just can't do it. What would you do?

Our rent will increase again in November, and for the amount they are asking we could have an additional bedroom out where Ryan lives. However, that would mean an hour of commuting in each direction, whereas at present I walk to work in twelve minutes. Every time I work out the figures it makes sense on paper, and then I imagine myself making that drive in February and I simply cannot do it. What would you do?

sentences.note: **for what they're asking**은 그쪽이 부르는 값이면, 그 돈이면 이라는 뜻입니다. **on paper**는 계산상으로는 맞는데 실제로는 다르다고 할 때 씁니다.

sentences.ko: 여기까지 차 몰고 오시기 전에 말씀드릴 게 있어요. 뒷바퀴가 일주일쯤은 바람이 차 있다가 그다음엔 물렁해져요. 아마 튜브만 갈면 될 텐데 제가 계속 미루기만 했어요. 나머지는 다 멀쩡하고요, 이사하는 바람에 안 타게 된 것뿐이에요. 그래서 보통 이런 게 나가는 값 말고 90달러로 내놓은 거예요. 주말 내내 집에 있으니까 보러 오셔도 돼요.
sentences.text: Before you drive all the way out here, I should tell you the back tire holds air for about a week and then it goes soft, so it's probably just the tube, I never got around to it. Everything else on it is solid, I only stopped riding because I moved. That's why I've got it at ninety instead of what these usually go for, and I'm around all weekend if you want to come look at it.

alts.text: Heads up before you drive all the way out here, the back tire holds air for about a week and then it goes soft, so it's probably just the tube, I never got around to it. Everything else on it is solid, I only stopped riding because I moved. That's why I've got it at ninety instead of what these usually go for, and I'm around all weekend if you wanna come look at it.

Before you drive all the way out here, I should mention that the rear tire holds air for approximately a week and then goes soft, so it is most likely just the tube, which I never got around to replacing. Everything else on it is in good condition. I stopped riding it only because I moved. That is why I have priced it at ninety rather than what these normally sell for, and I am available all weekend if you would like to come and look at it.

sentences.note: **got around to it**은 마음은 있었는데 결국 손을 못 댔다는 말입니다. **what these usually go for**의 go for는 그 물건이 보통 얼마에 팔린다는 뜻입니다.
sentences.situation: 중고로 물건 팔면서 상태 솔직히 말하기

sentences.ko: 배송 조회에는 목요일 2시에 배달됐다고 나와요. 저는 2시에 집에 있었고요. 복도에도 없고 이웃집에서 대신 받아 둔 것도 아니에요. 그래서 사이트에서 접수 양식을 넣었더니, 혹시 나올지 모르니 48시간만 기다려 보라는 답이 왔어요. 안 나와요! 그 택배가 딸 생일 선물인데 생일이 일요일이란 말이에요.
sentences.text: The tracking says it was delivered Thursday at two, and I was home at two, and it's not in the hallway and none of the neighbors have it. So I filled out the form on their site, and they came back and told me to give it forty eight hours in case it turns up. It's not going to turn up! And it's my daughter's birthday present, and her birthday is Sunday.

alts.text: So according to the tracking it got delivered Thursday at two, and I was home at two, and it's not in the hallway and none of the neighbors have it. So I filled out the form on their site, and they came back and told me to give it forty eight hours in case it shows up. It's not gonna show up! And it's my daughter's birthday present, and her birthday is Sunday.

The tracking indicates that it was delivered on Thursday at two, and I was at home at two, yet it is not in the hallway and none of the neighbors have it. I therefore completed the form on their website, and they replied telling me to allow forty eight hours in case it turns up. It is not going to turn up. It is my daughter's birthday present, and her birthday is on Sunday.

sentences.note: **turn up**은 없어진 물건이 어딘가에서 툭 나타난다는 뜻입니다. **came back**은 문의에 대해 답이 돌아왔다는 말입니다.

reviewed: 2번 formal 의 시제를 고쳤습니다 — 'I had not done anything since March' 는 과거완료라 '지금까지 안 했다'는 뜻이 흐려집니다. 뒷문장이 현재('My calves are now...')라 시제도 어긋났습니다. 'I have not done anything since March' 로 맞췄습니다.
4번 casual 의 콜론을 쉼표로 바꿨습니다 — 'Heads up before you drive all the way out here:' 는 글로 적을 때 쓰는 모양이고, 말로 하면 그냥 이어 말합니다.
3번 casual 의 'out by Ryan' 을 'out by Ryan's' 로 고쳤습니다 — 사람 이름만 쓰면 사람 옆이라는 말이 되고, 동네를 가리킬 때는 그 사람 집(Ryan's)을 씁니다.
